task_description: Write a method in Dafny to convert a given sequence of positive integers into a single integer.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method SequenceToInteger(seq: seq<int>) returns (num: int)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The returned integer is the concatenation of all positive integers in the sequence
- The sequence is not empty
- The sequence contains only positive integers
- The resulting integer accurately represents the concatenation of the sequence elements in order
